defaults.description: Cross-provider code/work review (Opus 5.5 + GPT-6.1 Sol; GPT-6 Astra with deep: true); only blocking findings gate, verified by the other provider
defaults.whenToUse: Reviewing a diff, change set, document or plan before it is merged or published; pass author, round and full SHAs.

phases.title: Review
phases.detail: Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol (Astra in deep mode) review independently, plus a cross-provider security lens

phases.title: Verify
phases.detail: each finding is challenged by the other provider

fullSummary: Full mode (default): Claude Opus 5.5 (`reviewer`) and GPT-6.1 Sol (`sol-reviewer`, high)
review independently; each one's findings are then checked by the OTHER provider,
which tries to refute them. Only findings that survive are reported as confirmed.
The Opus review runs at the reviewer agent's medium effort (Opus 5.5 medium >= xhigh, Oct 2026);
verification runs at each agent's default effort.
deepSummary: Deep mode (`deep: true`): the GPT side uses GPT-6 Astra (`second-opinion`, high) instead of
Sol, for both its review and its verification of Opus's findings. Reserve it for
security-sensitive, concurrency/algorithmic or large cross-cutting changes — it costs
